small_guidance: Reorder loops so IC is the outer reduction and (kd,kh,kw) inner; precompute base x offset per ic to amortize address math. Add configs with BLOCK_OC=64, BLOCK_SPATIAL=32 and num_warps=4/num_stages=3 to raise occupancy (currently register-limited at 128 regs/thread, 33% occupancy). Cache weight tile [BLOCK_OC, IC*KD*KH*KW] in registers across spatial tile to amortize loads.
large_guidance: Rewrite ConvTranspose3d as an explicit GEMM: form M=OC, N=N*OD*OH*OW spatial, K=IC*KD*KH*KW with implicit im2col-style scatter indexing using tl.dot, blocked tiles (BM=64,BN=64,BK=32) so the dominant work uses tensor-core-style matmul instead of scalar FMAs (current kernel is compute-bound at 62% with no shared mem usage). Alternatively, use the gather formulation: one program per (N, OC tile, output spatial tile), loop over IC in chunks loading weight and input tiles into shared memory with tl.dot. Fuse BN (fold running stats into weight/bias at forward) and the spatial mean-subtraction epilogue into the conv kernel by having each program reduce its spatial tile partial sums into a global atomic accumulator, then a second small kernel subtracts the mean.
